nodes:
  - id: classify
    command: classify-issue
    output_format:
      type: object
      properties:
        type: { type: string, enum: [BUG, FEATURE] }
      required: [type]

  - id: fix
    prompt: |
      The issue was classified as: $classify.output.type
      Full classification: $classify.output
      User's original request: $USER_MESSAGE
    depends_on: [classify]
